description: The trained models behind the NM26 tracks, published as assets of a GitHub release (docs/models.md). Fetch with python3 scripts/fetch-models.py; each file is checked against its sha256. status: exact = the file that produced the committed tracks; retrained = rebuilt from the repo scripts (tracks rebuilt from it may differ slightly). All model outputs are PROPOSED.
